mentl/e87988c:
The verification law was already written. CLAUDE.md ⊕ has carried "X is
the cause is a claim until a trace shows it" for months, and the memory
protocol recording the same failure mode dates from 2026-06-14. Both
were in the read path while five causes were asserted and refuted across
two iterations of one defect. More prose is not the fix; the two things
actually missing are.

First, the gate sat on asserting. "Do not assert" leaves the guess free
to steer the next edit, and it did. No edit, no doc entry, no commit
message acts on a cause the artifact has not shown this turn — and
labelling it a hypothesis is not the fix, because labelling is
decoration and the guess lands in the record either way.

Second, there was no stated alternative output, so failure pressure
manufactured an explanation. A loop that must report something every
iteration will report a story when it cannot report a build. When the
reason is unmeasured the output is the next instrument, and that is a
full result. Treating "I do not know yet" as failure is what produces
the fabrication.

The memory protocol is updated in place rather than duplicated, and it
now records the recurrence, which is the part worth keeping: a law in
the read path did not hold, so the change had to be to the incentive and
the gate rather than to the wording.

morph position/speed, graph-level gains, and a whole-rig bypass — built from a

identical in the DAW (graph-player plugin) and on the pedal (firmware patch
player) — both just wrap a PatchPlayer.

two-closure aliasing). 5 runtime tests: macro drives a param, macro→master
volume global, A/B morph, bypass passthrough, build+run. no_std thumbv7em clean.

perennials/e8e6052:
The yard was the one room in the house where her answers went silent. It
read p.functions, p.attracts, p.layer and p.bloomColor raw, so a bloom
colour she recorded filtered the browse grid, counted in the rail, moved
coverage, and never painted the mark on her own sheet; a function she
wrote never reached "ask the yard"; a layer she filled left the figure in
the plain column. CLAUDE.md already states the rule this violates: ACCESS
is the single place the guide asks what a plant is, and reading fields
directly anywhere else means the rest of the list silently doesn't follow.

Every read goes through ACCESS now, with the same per-plant lookup the
rest of the guide uses. Her "purple" arrives in the catalogue's spelling
and finds its swatch, so it fills the mark in all three projections; her
functions and visitors join the ask menu and its rings and its counts; a
layer she filled shapes the figure where the record is silent, and the
record's own layer always speaks first. A colour of her own coinage stays
true and unpaintable: "cream" has no swatch, and the mark keeps to the
states that claim nothing they can't show.
